placement: Tooling / Conformance. A store benchmark page (bench/pages/store/) drives limen.store version 2 through the real kernel and the JSON boundary every WebAssembly transport pays (serialize, parse, strict decode with the generated codecs, as bench's json boundary), for every LCP-078 row: open existing and new, a small put and get, a 100-record query, a 64 KB and a 1 MB snapshot load and save, and a 1 MB one-time localStorage migration. scripts/bench.ts runs it in Chromium and WebKit (npm run bench -- --only store), records the results, and fails when a p95 exceeds its budget. The provisional LCP-078 budgets are replaced with measured ones in bench/budgets.json, the requirements and docs/41; the F# package's size in a trimmed WebAssembly publish is measured and recorded. Timings stay out of CI, as for every other bench. No pack, contract or Core change.
